verdict.rationale: Token2's tools are FIDO2/PIV/OTP key-management utilities. The only event-driven behavior in the evidence is a fixed watcher that opens the GUI when a key is inserted. That is a hardcoded adjacent feature, not a facility for users to define their own rules that trigger actions on events, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: A small headless watcher (`fido2_tray.py`) can open the GUI automatically when a supported key is inserted.
